patch_description: Add a short, degree-preserving path from the current parent toward a high-quality network already scored. Ordinary local moves can improve the parent, but may not connect it to a better region of the search space; the intermediate networks on this path give the LP a chance to find useful stepping stones. Each step uses a two-switch that strictly increases the number of shared links with the target, so the path makes progress and cannot cycle. The path is bounded to keep its generation cost small.
